title: Choreographing himself; Hawks, Lena Horne and Ellington
summary: Nobody choreographed him; he calls Howard Hawks a nice director and everyone fine to work with.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: What's interesting, you were not only an actor but you created so much of your act even to the extent of Hollywood films. You weren't given the type of dance -- nobody choreographed you, did they?
Interesting. What was it like working under Howard Hawks?
Was there anything in particular that he --
No, just a nice guy, that's all, as director.
How about working with Lena Horne and Duke Ellington --
Did you establish a relationship with them?
Oh, surely. Friendship relations, is about all I could establish.
